description: This file declares the DoorBell class and its nested Connector class, which are part of the WPEFramework::Core namespace. It defines the interface for a doorbell resource, including methods for ringing, acknowledging, waiting, and handling doorbell signals, as well as internal socket communication mechanisms.

classes.name: DoorBell
classes.description: Represents a doorbell resource with methods to ring, acknowledge, wait, and handle doorbell signals, including internal socket communication.

classes.name: DoorBell::Connector
classes.description: Handles socket-based communication for the DoorBell, including binding, unbinding, sending, and receiving doorbell signals.

methods.name: DoorBell::Ring
methods.description: Triggers the doorbell signal and sets the internal event.

methods.name: DoorBell::Wait
methods.description: Waits for the doorbell event to be signaled within a specified timeout.

methods.name: DoorBell::Ringing
methods.description: Sets the internal event to indicate the doorbell has rung.
